title: Support pi 1.4.0 in the bee Pi belt
action: D1 (red first): in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs add a contract test that fires before_agent_start with {messageType: custom, message: {...}, systemPrompt: BASE} and NO prompt, on a store where prompt-context would inject (reuse the fixture of the existing test near line 3065 that proves the preamble injection on the first turn). Assert: the handler does not throw, returns no systemPrompt change, logs no UserPromptSubmit activity row, and selfBusy is set so a result drained right after is steered (reuse the turn_starts and await_injections helpers). Run it and watch it fail for the reported reason, then change the before_agent_start handler in .pi/extensions/bee-guard/events.ts: keep the three state assignments before the try; inside, when event.messageType is a string and is not user, return undefined before the preamble, prompt-context and activity work. Keep the user and absent-messageType paths identical in behavior. D2: in the .pi/extensions/bee-guard/index.ts header block change the CEILING line to Pi 1.4.0 and name the live evidence: run pi -p with the prompt Reply with the single word ok, from the worktree root with the belt loaded (it must print ok and no extension error on stderr), and put the exact command plus the date in that line; keep every other version label in the file untouched (the header says why). D3: in docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/pi-version-pin-and-capability-audit.md update the Last live-evidence version row to 1.4.0 and add a section 1.0.0 to 1.4.0 with one row per changelog item that touches a belt surface, each with keep, adapt or delete: 1.2.0 before_agent_start messageType (adapt, D1, cite events.ts); 1.2.0 run-start busy window for sendUserMessage without deliverAs (keep: result-inbox.ts sendLeaderMessageOutcome catches the throw and resets turnStartPending, name the file and function, mark as re-probe); 1.2.0 before_agent_start also fires on sendMessage with triggerTurn true (keep: the belt only ever passes triggerTurn false); 1.3.0 resumed sessions keep active tools (keep: turn_start captures fullToolSet from getAllTools before getActiveTools, name events.ts); 1.4.0 compaction uses the model output limit (keep: the belt only observes session_before_compact); codemode parallel worker queue and PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS, published schemas, provider header attribution, model defaults (no belt surface). Update the title and description frontmatter to say 0.84.3 to 1.4.0. Regen: after the belt edit run the full chain in this cell: .bee/bin/bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write) and commit the manifest with the cell. No code comments anywhere except the existing header blocks you edit. One commit, subject in imperative mood, trailer cell: p14-1.
